result:
```dockerfile
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --ignore-scripts

FROM node:22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:22-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && npm cache clean --force
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

3 stages:

| Stage | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `deps` | Install all deps (including devDeps) with lockfile |
| `builder` | Compile TS → `dist/` |
| `runner` | Prod deps only + compiled output |

Key size cuts:
- `alpine` base (~5MB vs ~300MB for full Debian)
- `--omit=dev` drops TypeScript, ts-node, types, etc.
- `npm cache clean --force` removes npm cache from layer
- `--ignore-scripts` reduces attack surface on install
- `USER node` drops root privileges

Assumes `tsconfig.json` outputs to `dist/` and `package.json` has a `build` script (`tsc`). Adjust `dist/index.js` entrypoint as needed.
